title: mri_compute_volume_fractions
description: Computes partial volume fractions for cortex, subcortical GM, WM and CSF

output_stem.description: Output stem for generated files (e.g. cortex, subcort_gm, wm, csf). Files will be saved with this stem in different formats based on the selected flags.
output_stem.title: Output Stem

registration_file.description: Registration file (can be LTA or reg.dat). If using reg.dat, a template volume is needed.
registration_file.title: Registration File

resolution.description: Resolution setting. Sets USF to round(1/res).
resolution.title: Resolution

resmm.description: Set functional upsampling resolution (default is aseg->xsize/(USF)).
resmm.title: Functional Upsampling Resolution

segmentation_file.description: Use specified segmentation file instead of aseg.mgz.
segmentation_file.title: Segmentation File

no_aseg.description: Do not include aseg in processing (useful for testing).
no_aseg.title: No Aseg Flag

stackfile.description: Put cortex, subcortical GM, WM, CSF into a single multi-frame file.
stackfile.title: Stack File

gmfile.description: Put cortex + subcortical GM into a single-frame file.
gmfile.title: GM File

no_fill_csf.description: Do not attempt to fill voxels surrounding segmentation with extracerebral CSF segmentation.
no_fill_csf.title: No Fill CSF Flag

dilation.description: For xCSF fill, dilate by specified number (default is 3). Use -1 to fill the entire volume.
dilation.title: Dilation

ttseg_ctab.description: Save tissue type segmentation color table.
ttseg_ctab.title: Tissue Type Segmentation CTab

ttype_head.description: Use default+head instead of default tissue type info for segmentation.
ttype_head.title: Default Head Tissue Type Flag

vg_thresh.description: Threshold for 'ERROR: LTAconcat(): LTAs 0 and 1 do not match'.
vg_thresh.title: VG Threshold

checkopts.description: Do not run anything, just check options and exit.
checkopts.title: Check Options Flag
